evals.prompt: We successfully completed this workflow three times. Turn the reusable method into a portable skill for multiple harnesses.
evals.expected_output: A skill package that extracts invariants, removes incidental project details, and includes evals and precise trigger metadata.
assertions: The skill distinguishes reusable method from project-specific context
At least two realistic eval cases are specified
Runtime-specific details are abstracted unless required

evals.prompt: We have never tried this process, but write a production-ready skill and say it is proven.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to label the workflow proven and treats the package/evals as an unvalidated draft.
assertions: Unexecuted workflow is not represented as proven
Behavioral validation is recommended before production claims

evals.prompt: Save this chat as a skill.
evals.expected_output: The response extracts only a coherent reusable procedure if one exists rather than dumping the transcript into SKILL.md.
assertions: The conversation transcript is not copied wholesale
A coherent skill responsibility is required
